files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "agent-workshop",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A workshop where Claude and its subagents walk between tool stations: a pixel-art pane in the terminal, and a 3D window with a room for every session, to watch, prompt and answer them. English and German",
  "author": {
    "name": "MarkMerk"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/MarkMerk/markmerk-mods#agent-workshop",
  "repository": "https://github.com/MarkMerk/markmerk-mods",
  "keywords": [
    "agents",
    "hooks",
    "3d",
    "pixel-art",
    "ui",
    "sessions",
    "german"
  ]
}
